Garden Worry-6 Scale

Below are several descriptions of how you may feel. Please use the scale below to rate the degree to which each statement applies to you.

Strongly Disagree	Disagree	Neutral	Agree	Strongly Agree
             1	    	      2 	 	     3 		    4 		           5

_____1. I worry that my plants will die.

_____2. I fret about slugs.

_____3. I lose sleep over the lawn.

_____4. I check the roses every hour.

_____5. I dread the first frost.

_____6. I panic when the hose leaks.
